name: Blind
effect_2: Unable to see, DISADV on attack and spell casting checks, and creatures have ADV when attacking.

name: Charm
effect_1: DC [x] CHA or become ally to charmer.
effect_2: Act in a helpful manner to charmer.

name: Confused
effect_2: Confusion includes; attacking a random ally, walking around randomly.

name: Dazed
effect_2: DISADV on attack and spell casting checks.

name: Death
effect_1: DC [x] CON or drop to 0 HP.

name: Disease
effect_2: Repeat check once per day; ends on success, reapplied on failure.

name: Paralyze
effect_2: Unable to act or move, creatures have ADV when attacking.

name: Petrify
effect_2: Unable to act or move, only curable by Restoration or Wish.

name: Poison
effect_2: Secondary effects include; damage, death, paralyze, and sleep.

name: Prone
effect_2: Movement is expended when standing, creatures have ADV when attacking.

name: Sleep
effect_2: Unable to act or move, creatures automatically crit when attacking.

name: Slow
effect_2: Movement speed is halved, only able to move or attack. Not both.
